dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, in your opinion, what needs changing first in big cities?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ɪn jʊr əˈpɪnjən, ˈwʌt ˈniːdz ˈtʃeɪndʒɪŋ ˈfɜːrst ɪn ˈbɪɡ ˈsɪtiz?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Public services. The buses and hospitals in Bangkok need improving.
dialogue.reading: ˈpʌblɪk ˈsɜːrvɪsɪz. ðə ˈbʌsɪz ənd ˈhɑːspɪtəlz ɪn ˈbæŋkɑːk ˈniːd ɪmˈpruːvɪŋ.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: But where will the money come from?
dialogue.reading: bʌt ˈwɛr wɪl ðə ˈmʌni ˈkʌm ˈfrʌm?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Governments need to invest more. Without investment, nothing will change.
dialogue.reading: ˈɡʌvərnmənts ˈniːd tə ɪnˈvɛst ˈmɔːr. wɪˈðaʊt ɪnˈvɛstmənt, ˈnʌθɪŋ wɪl ˈtʃeɪndʒ.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: In some countries, the problem is corruption. Money for schools just disappears.
dialogue.reading: ɪn sʌm ˈkʌntriz, ðə ˈprɑːbləm ɪz kəˈrʌpʃən. ˈmʌni fər ˈskuːlz ˈdʒʌst ˌdɪsəˈpɪrz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: That's terrible. The system needs to be checked by independent experts.
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈtɛrəbəl. ðə ˈsɪstəm ˈniːdz tə bi ˈtʃɛkt baɪ ˌɪndɪˈpɛndənt ˈɛkspɜːrts.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: I agree. And public funds need to be spent on the right things.
dialogue.reading: aɪ əˈɡriː. ənd ˈpʌblɪk ˈfʌndz ˈniːd tə bi ˈspɛnt ɑːn ðə ˈraɪt ˈθɪŋz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: What about housing? Cheap housing is hard to find in Bangkok.
dialogue.reading: ˈwʌt əˈbaʊt ˈhaʊzɪŋ? ˈtʃiːp ˈhaʊzɪŋ ɪz ˈhɑːrd tə ˈfaɪnd ɪn ˈbæŋkɑːk.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: It's the same in Berlin. Many old apartment buildings need fixing.
dialogue.reading: ɪts ðə ˈseɪm ɪn bərˈlɪn. ˈmɛni ˈoʊld əˈpɑːrtmənt ˌbɪldɪŋz ˈniːd ˈfɪksɪŋ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: And new homes need to be built near public transportation.
dialogue.reading: ənd ˈnuː ˈhoʊmz ˈniːd tə bi ˈbɪlt ˈnɪr ˈpʌblɪk ˌtrænspərˈteɪʃən.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Good point. Should we put that in our speech?
dialogue.reading: ˈɡʊd ˈpɔɪnt. ʃʊd wiː ˈpʊt ðæt ɪn aʊər ˈspiːtʃ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes. Our speech needs finishing by tonight, so let's write it now!
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. aʊər ˈspiːtʃ ˈniːdz ˈfɪnɪʃɪŋ baɪ təˈnaɪt, soʊ ˈlɛts ˈraɪt ɪt ˈnaʊ!
